plain_language:
1. When the robot announces delivery, the user must acknowledge the delivery (via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds.  
2. When the user acknowledges delivery, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
ig_syntax:
robot announces delivery → user acknowledges delivery @within(8s)
user acknowledges delivery → robot provides final confirmation @within(1s)

provenance.source_text: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
